Remaining: desert, mountain, volcano. No listed question separates them cleanly, so I want the one that at least isolates one item.

"Does it give off light?" would be no for all three. A volcano might arguably give off light through lava, but that is ambiguous.

"Is it round?" is no for all three, or ambiguous at best.

"Is it mostly yellow?" would be yes for desert and no for the others, which splits 1 to 2.

"Is it mostly green?" is probably no for all three.

"Is it mostly red?" is probably no for all three.

Yellow is the clearest choice.
